Class InferenceTck

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.InferenceTck
public abstract class InferenceTck extends AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
Inference of method type arguments: wildcard capture and containment, bound checks, least upper bounds, generic variable arity calls and the requested return type. Each generated call must behave as javac's call on a compiled fixture.

A backend runs these tests by extending this class and implementing AbstractByteCodeWriterTck.write(io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.ObjectDef).

Since:
2.3

    • unboundedWildcardOfABoundedClassSelectsTheGenericOverload

      @Test public void unboundedWildcardOfABoundedClassSelectsTheGenericOverload() throws Exception
      An unbounded wildcard of a class that declares its parameter with a bound is captured with that bound: a BoundedBoxFixtures.NumberBox<?> holds Numbers, so <T extends Number> boxed(BoundedBoxFixtures.NumberBox<T>) applies and is more specific than boxed(Object). The capture took only the wildcard's own bound, so the generic overload did not apply and the call went to boxed(Object). It was right before PR 518.
